name: Inquiry
例文: I am writing to make an inquiry about the internship requirements.
例文翻译: 我写信是想询问关于实习要求的事宜。

name: Alternative
例文: We need to consider an alternative date for the final presentation.
例文翻译: 我们需要为最终演示考虑一个备选日期。

name: Accommodate
例文: Could you please accommodate my request for a late submission?
例文翻译: 您能通融一下我迟交作业的请求吗？

name: Clarify
例文: I would like to clarify the instructions for the lab report.
例文翻译: 我想进一步明确一下实验报告的要求。

name: Extension
例文: I am writing to request a one-week extension on the research paper.
例文翻译: 我写信是想申请将研究论文延期一周。

name: Relevant
例文: My relevant experience makes me a strong candidate for the library job.
例文翻译: 我相关的经验使我成为图书馆工作的有力竞争者。

name: Contribution
例文: Your contribution to the online discussion was highly insightful.
例文翻译: 你对线上讨论的贡献非常有见地。

name: Perspective
例文: From a historical perspective this policy has many flaws.
例文翻译: 从历史的角度来看，这项政策有很多缺陷。

name: Compelling
例文: The author provides a compelling argument for environmental protection.
例文翻译: 作者为环境保护提供了极具说服力的论证。

name: Objective
例文: The main objective of this study is to analyze urban growth.
例文翻译: 本研究的主要目标是分析城市增长。

name: Attribute
例文: The success of the project is attributed to the team's collaboration.
例文翻译: 项目的成功归因于团队的协作。

name: Notwithstanding
例文: Notwithstanding the budget cuts the research will continue.
例文翻译: 尽管预算削减，研究仍将继续。

name: Conversely
例文: The first group improved; conversely the second group showed no change.
例文翻译: 第一组进步了；相反，第二组没有变化。

name: Paradoxically
例文: Paradoxically some plants thrive in very poor soil conditions.
例文翻译: 自相矛盾的是，有些植物在非常贫瘠的土壤中反而生长茂盛。

name: Consequently
例文: The experiment failed; consequently we had to restart the process.
例文翻译: 实验失败了，因此我们不得不重新开始。

name: Simultaneously
例文: The two chemical reactions occur simultaneously in the beaker.
例文翻译: 这两种化学反应在烧杯中同时发生。

name: Substantial
例文: There has been a substantial increase in online learning recently.
例文翻译: 最近在线学习有了大幅增长。

name: Marginal
例文: The improvement in the student's score was only marginal.
例文翻译: 这个学生分数的提升非常微小。

name: Aesthetic
例文: The building's design has high aesthetic value but low functionality.
例文翻译: 这栋建筑的设计有很高的美学价值，但实用性较低。

name: Cognitive
例文: Social media has a significant impact on children's cognitive development.
例文翻译: 社交媒体对儿童的认知发展有显著影响。

name: Sovereignty
例文: The treaty respects the sovereignty of all participating nations.
例文翻译: 该条约尊重所有参与国的主权。

name: Excavate
例文: Archaeologists plan to excavate the site early next year.
例文翻译: 考古学家计划于明年年初挖掘该遗址。

name: Symbiosis
例文: The relationship between the two species is a perfect example of symbiosis.
例文翻译: 这两个物种之间的关系是共生的完美范例。

name: Metabolism
例文: Exercise is known to increase your body's metabolism.
例文翻译: 众所周知，运动能提高身体的新陈代谢。

name: Sediment
例文: The river carries a large amount of sediment to the ocean.
例文翻译: 河流将大量的沉积物带入海洋。

name: Tectonic
例文: Tectonic plate movements can cause massive earthquakes.
例文翻译: 地壳板块运动会导致大地震。

name: Artifact
例文: The museum displays various artifacts from the Ming Dynasty.
例文翻译: 博物馆展示了明代的各种文物。

name: Aesthetic
例文: The artist's work is known for its unique aesthetic style.
例文翻译: 这位艺术家的作品以其独特的美学风格而闻名。

name: Feasible
例文: The professor asked if the proposed research plan was feasible.
例文翻译: 教授询问所提议的研究计划是否可行。

name: Collaborate
例文: Students are encouraged to collaborate on the final project.
例文翻译: 鼓励学生在最终项目上进行合作。

name: Conflict
例文: I have a schedule conflict between the chemistry lab and the seminar.
例文翻译: 我的化学实验和研讨会在时间上有冲突。

name: Consent
例文: We need your parent's written consent to join the field trip.
例文翻译: 我们需要你父母的书面同意书才能参加实地考察。

name: Notify
例文: Please notify the office if your contact information changes.
例文翻译: 如果你的联系信息有变，请通知办公室。

name: Propose
例文: I would like to propose a new topic for the class discussion.
例文翻译: 我想为课堂讨论提议一个新话题。

name: Resolve
例文: The university is working to resolve the technical issues.
例文翻译: 大学正在努力解决技术问题。

name: Sufficient
例文: We have sufficient evidence to support our hypothesis.
例文翻译: 我们有充分的证据来支持我们的假设。

name: Initial
例文: My initial reaction to the news was one of great surprise.
例文翻译: 我对那个消息最初的反应是极度惊讶。

name: Incorporate
例文: We should incorporate more case studies into the curriculum.
例文翻译: 我们应该在课程中加入更多的案例研究。

name: Advocate
例文: She is a strong advocate for student rights on campus.
例文翻译: 她是校园学生权利的坚定倡导者。

name: Assess
例文: The teacher will assess our progress through a weekly quiz.
例文翻译: 老师将通过每周小测验来评估我们的进度。

name: Assume
例文: Many people assume that technology always makes life easier.
例文翻译: 许多人假设技术总是让生活变得更简单。

name: Constitute
例文: These three modules constitute the entire software package.
例文翻译: 这三个模块构成了整个软件包。

name: Derive
例文: Many English words are derived from Latin roots.
例文翻译: 许多英语单词源于拉丁语词根。

name: Distribute
例文: The library will distribute the new ID cards next week.
例文翻译: 图书馆下周将发放新的身份证。

name: Establish
例文: The researchers established a link between diet and health.
例文翻译: 研究人员建立了饮食与健康之间的联系。

name: Identify
例文: The software is designed to identify potential security threats.
例文翻译: 该软件旨在识别潜在的安全威胁。

name: Indicate
例文: The survey results indicate a change in consumer behavior.
例文翻译: 调查结果表明消费者行为发生了变化。

name: Interpret
例文: It is difficult to interpret the meaning of this ancient text.
例文翻译: 很难解释这段古文的含义。

name: Investigate
例文: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
例文翻译: 警方正在调查事故的原因。

name: Manifest
例文: The symptoms of the disease usually manifest within a week.
例文翻译: 这种疾病的症状通常在一周内显现。

name: Potential
例文: The new technology has the potential to transform the industry.
例文翻译: 这项新技术具有改变行业的潜力。

name: Diverse
例文: The campus has a very diverse student population.
例文翻译: 校园里有非常多样化的学生群体。

name: Fundamental
例文: Understanding grammar is fundamental to learning a new language.
例文翻译: 理解语法是学习一门新语言的基础。

name: Precise
例文: Scientists need precise measurements to ensure the accuracy of the experiment.
例文翻译: 科学家需要精确的测量以确保实验的准确性。

name: Significant
例文: There has been a significant improvement in your writing skills.
例文翻译: 你的写作能力有了显著提高。

name: Sustainable
例文: The university is promoting sustainable practices on campus.
例文翻译: 大学正在校园内推广可持续的做法。

name: Vulnerable
例文: Young children are particularly vulnerable to air pollution.
例文翻译: 幼儿特别容易受到空气污染的影响。

name: Empirical
例文: The theory is supported by a wealth of empirical evidence.
例文翻译: 该理论得到了丰富的实证支持。

name: Hypothesis
例文: Scientists are testing the hypothesis through a series of experiments.
例文翻译: 科学家们正通过一系列实验来测试这个假设。

name: Validate
例文: The data will be used to validate the previous findings.
例文翻译: 这些数据将用于验证之前的发现。

name: Pragmatic
例文: We need to take a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
例文翻译: 我们需要采取务实的方法来解决问题。

name: Abstract
例文: The concept of justice is often discussed in abstract terms.
例文翻译: 正义的概念经常以抽象的形式被讨论。

name: Analyze
例文: Researchers will analyze the data using statistical software.
例文翻译: 研究人员将使用统计软件分析数据。

name: Synthesize
例文: You need to synthesize information from multiple sources for the paper.
例文翻译: 你需要为论文综合来自多个来源的信息。

name: Comprehensive
例文: The textbook provides a comprehensive overview of the subject.
例文翻译: 这本教科书提供了该学科的全面概述。

name: Ambiguous
例文: The instructions were so ambiguous that no one knew what to do.
例文翻译: 指令非常模棱两可，以至于没人知道该做什么。

name: Implicit
例文: There was an implicit agreement between the two companies.
例文翻译: 两家公司之间存在一项默契协议。

name: Explicit
例文: The teacher gave explicit instructions on how to format the essay.
例文翻译: 老师就如何排版作文给出了明确的指示。

name: Hierarchy
例文: The social hierarchy of the colony was clearly defined.
例文翻译: 该殖民地的社会等级制度定义非常明确。

name: Precursor
例文: The small protest was a precursor to the major revolution.
例文翻译: 小规模的抗议是大革命的前兆。

name: Sovereignty
例文: The nation fought to maintain its territorial sovereignty.
例文翻译: 该国为维护其领土主权而战。

name: Urbanization
例文: Urbanization has led to a decrease in agricultural land.
例文翻译: 城市化导致了农用地的减少。

name: Demographics
例文: The demographics of the city have changed significantly over the years.
例文翻译: 这些年来，这座城市的人口结构发生了显著变化。

name: Innovation
例文: Technical innovation is key to staying competitive in the market.
例文翻译: 技术创新是在市场中保持竞争力的关键。

name: Rational
例文: Is there a rational explanation for your decision?
例文翻译: 你的决定有合理的解释吗？

name: Bias
例文: The study was criticized for having a cultural bias.
例文翻译: 该研究因具有文化偏见而受到批评。

name: Criteria
例文: The main criteria for the scholarship are academic excellence.
例文翻译: 奖学金的主要标准是学业优秀。

name: Dimension
例文: There is another dimension to the problem that we haven't considered.
例文翻译: 这个问题还有另一个我们尚未考虑的维度。

name: Entity
例文: The two companies operate as separate legal entities.
例文翻译: 这两家公司作为独立的法人实体运营。

name: Mechanism
例文: The mechanism of the lock is quite complicated.
例文翻译: 锁的机制相当复杂。

name: Norm
例文: Working from home has become the norm for many people.
例文翻译: 在家办公已成为许多人的常态。

name: Parallel
例文: There are many parallels between the two historical events.
例文翻译: 这两个历史事件之间有许多相似之处。

name: Qualitative
例文: The researchers conducted qualitative interviews with the participants.
例文翻译: 研究人员对参与者进行了定性访谈。

name: Quantitative
例文: Quantitative analysis is based on numerical data.
例文翻译: 定量分析是基于数字数据的。

name: Scope
例文: The scope of the project is larger than we initially thought.
例文翻译: 该项目的范围比我们最初设想的要大。

name: Underly
例文: Deep-seated fears underly much of his behavior.
例文翻译: 根深蒂固的恐惧是他大部分行为的基础。

name: Utility
例文: The utility of the new tool is still being debated.
例文翻译: 这个新工具的效用仍在讨论中。

name: Variable
例文: Temperature is an important variable in this experiment.
例文翻译: 温度是本实验中的一个重要变量。

name: Voluntary
例文: Participation in the survey is entirely voluntary.
例文翻译: 参加调查完全是自愿的。

name: Widespread
例文: There is widespread concern about the impact of climate change.
例文翻译: 人们对气候变化的影响存在广泛的担忧。

name: Analogous
例文: The heart is analogous to a pump.
例文翻译: 心脏类似于泵。

name: Coherent
例文: The witness gave a coherent account of the accident.
例文翻译: 证人对事故给出了连贯的陈述。

name: Discrete
例文: The data is broken down into discrete categories.
例文翻译: 数据被分解为离散的类别。

name: Enormous
例文: The project required an enormous amount of time and effort.
例文翻译: 该项目需要大量的时间和精力。

name: Inherent
例文: There are inherent risks in any investment.
例文翻译: 任何投资都存在固有风险。

name: Intrinsic
例文: Hard work is intrinsic to success.
例文翻译: 努力工作是成功的本质要求。

name: Passive
例文: Students should not be passive learners in the classroom.
例文翻译: 学生在课堂上不应是被动学习者。

name: Refined
例文: The theory was refined after more research was conducted.
例文翻译: 在进行了更多研究后，该理论得到了完善。

name: Subordinate
例文: In many societies women were historically subordinate to men.
例文翻译: 在许多社会中，女性在历史上一直从属于男性。

name: Versatile
例文: The new software is extremely versatile and easy to use.
例文翻译: 这款新软件功能极其多样且易于使用。

name: Acknowledge
例文: The professor acknowledged that the test was difficult.
例文翻译: 教授承认考试很难。

name: Acquire
例文: She acquired a lot of knowledge during her stay in London.
例文翻译: 她在伦敦逗留期间获得了大量知识。

name: Adapt
例文: It takes time to adapt to a new culture.
例文翻译: 适应一种新文化需要时间。

name: Advocate
例文: They advocate for stricter environmental regulations.
例文翻译: 他们主张实行更严格的环境法规。

name: Analyze
例文: Scientists analyze the samples in the laboratory.
例文翻译: 科学家在实验室里分析样本。

name: Appreciate
例文: I would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
例文翻译: 如果你能在周五前回复，我将不胜感激。

name: Assess
例文: The committee will assess the impact of the new policy.
例文翻译: 委员会将评估新政策的影响。

name: Assume
例文: Let's assume that the plan is successful.
例文翻译: 让我们假设这个计划是成功的。

name: Clarify
例文: I need to clarify some points in the contract.
例文翻译: 我需要澄清合同中的一些要点。

name: Communicate
例文: Good leaders know how to communicate effectively.
例文翻译: 优秀的领导者知道如何有效沟通。

name: Compare
例文: Compare your answers with those of your partner.
例文翻译: 将你的答案与搭档的答案进行比较。

name: Conclude
例文: The researchers concluded that the drug was effective.
例文翻译: 研究人员得出结论，该药物是有效的。

name: Conduct
例文: We will conduct a survey to gather student opinions.
例文翻译: 我们将进行一项调查以收集学生的意见。

name: Confirm
例文: Please confirm your attendance by email.
例文翻译: 请通过邮件确认你的出席。

name: Consider
例文: We are considering moving to a larger office.
例文翻译: 我们正在考虑搬到更大的办公室。

name: Consist
例文: The committee consists of ten members.
例文翻译: 委员会由十名成员组成。

name: Construct
例文: The bridge was constructed in the 19th century.
例文翻译: 这座桥建于19世纪。

name: Consult
例文: You should consult a specialist before making a decision.
例文翻译: 在做决定之前，你应该咨询专家。

name: Contrast
例文: Contrast the different styles of the two painters.
例文翻译: 对比这两位画家不同的风格。

name: Contribute
例文: Every member of the team contributed to the success.
例文翻译: 团队的每一位成员都为成功做出了贡献。

name: Coordinate
例文: We need to coordinate our efforts to finish the project.
例文翻译: 我们需要协调努力来完成这个项目。

name: Define
例文: How would you define the term "success"?
例文翻译: 你会如何定义“成功”这个词？

name: Demonstrate
例文: The experiment demonstrates the laws of physics.
例文翻译: 这个实验证明了物理定律。

name: Describe
例文: Describe the person you admire most.
例文翻译: 描述你最钦佩的人。

name: Design
例文: He designed the building's interior.
例文翻译: 他设计了这栋建筑的室内装修。

name: Determine
例文: The weather will determine whether we go or not.
例文翻译: 天气将决定我们是否出发。

name: Develop
例文: The company is developing a new line of products.
例文翻译: 公司正在开发一系列新产品。

name: Discuss
例文: We will discuss the topic in the next class.
例文翻译: 我们将在下一节课讨论这个话题。

name: Distinguish
例文: It's hard to distinguish between the two colors.
例文翻译: 很难区分这两个颜色。

name: Effect
例文: The new law will have a major effect on the economy.
例文翻译: 新法律将对经济产生重大影响。

name: Emphasize
例文: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular practice.
例文翻译: 老师强调了定期练习的重要性。

name: Enable
例文: Technology enables us to communicate across borders.
例文翻译: 技术使我们能够跨国界沟通。

name: Encourage
例文: Parents should encourage their children to read more.
例文翻译: 父母应该鼓励孩子多读书。

name: Ensure
例文: Please ensure that all the doors are locked.
例文翻译: 请确保所有的门都锁好了。

name: Establish
例文: The school was established in 1920.
例文翻译: 这所学校建于1920年。

name: Evaluate
例文: The judges will evaluate each performance.
例文翻译: 评委将评估每一场表演。

name: Examine
例文: The doctor examined the patient carefully.
例文翻译: 医生仔细检查了病人。

name: Explain
例文: Can you explain how this machine works?
例文翻译: 你能解释一下这台机器是怎么运作的吗？

name: Explore
例文: We need to explore all possible solutions.
例文翻译: 我们需要探索所有可能的解决方案。

name: Focus
例文: The lecture will focus on modern history.
例文翻译: 讲座将聚焦于现代史。

name: Identify
例文: Can you identify the person in the photo?
例文翻译: 你能认出照片里的那个人吗？

name: Illustrate
例文: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the point.
例文翻译: 老师用图表来说明这一点。

name: Implement
例文: The government is planning to implement new tax laws.
例文翻译: 政府正计划实施新的税收法律。

name: Improve
例文: I want to improve my English speaking skills.
例文翻译: 我想提高我的英语口语技能。

name: Include
例文: The price includes tax and shipping.
例文翻译: 价格包括税费和运费。

name: Increase
例文: The population of the city is increasing rapidly.
例文翻译: 这座城市的人口正在迅速增加。

name: Indicate
例文: A high fever indicates an infection.
例文翻译: 高烧表明有感染。

name: Influence
例文: His parents had a big influence on his career choice.
例文翻译: 他的父母对他的职业选择有很大影响。

name: Inform
例文: Please inform us of any changes to your schedule.
例文翻译: 如果你的日程有变，请通知我们。

name: Integrate
例文: The new system integrates all the different departments.
例文翻译: 新系统整合了所有不同的部门。

name: Interpret
例文: He interpreted the speech for the foreign visitors.
例文翻译: 他为外宾口译了演说。

name: Investigate
例文: The scientists are investigating the new phenomenon.
例文翻译: 科学家们正在调查这一新现象。

name: Involve
例文: The project involves a lot of research.
例文翻译: 这个项目涉及大量的研究。

name: Justify
例文: How can you justify the cost of this project?
例文翻译: 你如何证明这个项目的成本是合理的？

name: Maintain
例文: It's important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
例文翻译: 保持健康的生活方式很重要。

name: Manage
例文: She manages a team of twenty people.
例文翻译: 她管理着一个二十人的团队。

name: Measure
例文: We need to measure the dimensions of the room.
例文翻译: 我们需要测量房间的尺寸。

name: Modify
例文: The plan was modified based on the feedback.
例文翻译: 计划根据反馈进行了修改。

name: Monitor
例文: The security system monitors the entire building.
例文翻译: 安保系统监控着整栋建筑。

name: Motivate
例文: The coach knows how to motivate the players.
例文翻译: 教练知道如何激励球员。

name: Observe
例文: Scientists observe the behavior of animals in the wild.
例文翻译: 科学家观察野生动物的行为。

name: Obtain
例文: You need to obtain a permit before starting the work.
例文翻译: 在开始工作前，你需要获得许可证。

name: Organize
例文: We are organizing a charity event next month.
例文翻译: 我们下个月正在组织一场慈善活动。

name: Participate
例文: Many students participate in extracurricular activities.
例文翻译: 许多学生参加课外活动。

name: Perceive
例文: He perceived a change in her attitude.
例文翻译: 他察觉到她态度的变化。

name: Perform
例文: The surgeon performed the operation successfully.
例文翻译: 外科医生成功地执行了手术。

name: Persuade
例文: I tried to persuade him to join our team.
例文翻译: 我试图说服他加入我们的团队。

name: Predict
例文: It's hard to predict the future.
例文翻译: 很难预测未来。

name: Prepare
例文: The students are preparing for the final exam.
例文翻译: 学生们正在准备期末考试。

name: Present
例文: She presented her research at the conference.
例文翻译: 她在会议上介绍了她的研究。

name: Promote
例文: The company is promoting a new brand of coffee.
例文翻译: 公司正在推广一种新品牌的咖啡。

name: Propose
例文: The committee proposed a new set of rules.
例文翻译: 委员会建议了一套新规则。

name: Provide
例文: The school provides free lunch for all students.
例文翻译: 学校为所有学生提供免费午餐。

name: Publish
例文: The book was published last year.
例文翻译: 这本书是去年出版的。

name: Recognize
例文: I didn't recognize him at first.
例文翻译: 我起初没认出他。

name: Reduce
例文: We need to reduce our carbon footprint.
例文翻译: 我们需要减少碳足迹。

name: Reflect
例文: The mirror reflects the light.
例文翻译: 镜子反射光线。

name: Regulate
例文: The government regulates the banking industry.
例文翻译: 政府管制银行业。

name: Reinforce
例文: The teacher reinforced the lesson with more examples.
例文翻译: 老师通过更多的例子加强了课程内容。

name: Reject
例文: The proposal was rejected by the board.
例文翻译: 提议被董事会拒绝了。

name: Relate
例文: How does this topic relate to the previous one?
例文翻译: 这个话题与前一个有什么联系？

name: Release
例文: The film was released in early June.
例文翻译: 影片于六月初上映。

name: Rely
例文: We rely on technology for almost everything.
例文翻译: 我们几乎在所有事情上都依赖技术。

name: Remove
例文: Please remove your shoes before entering.
例文翻译: 进入前请脱鞋。

name: Require
例文: The job requires a high level of skill.
例文翻译: 这份工作要求很高的技能水平。

name: Research
例文: Scientists are researching a cure for the disease.
例文翻译: 科学家正在研究治愈这种疾病的方法。

name: Respond
例文: He didn't respond to my email.
例文翻译: 他没有回我的邮件。

name: Select
例文: Please select the best answer from the options.
例文翻译: 请从选项中选择最佳答案。

name: Simulate
例文: The flight simulator simulates real flying conditions.
例文翻译: 飞行模拟器模拟真实的飞行条件。

name: Solve
例文: We need to solve this problem as soon as possible.
例文翻译: 我们需要尽快解决这个问题。

name: Specify
例文: Please specify which color you would like.
例文翻译: 请说明你想要哪种颜色。

name: Stimulate
例文: The new policy aims to stimulate economic growth.
例文翻译: 新政策旨在刺激经济增长。

name: Study
例文: He is studying for a master's degree.
例文翻译: 他正在攻读硕士学位。

name: Succeed
例文: If you work hard you will succeed.
例文翻译: 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。

name: Suggest
例文: I suggest that we take a break.
例文翻译: 我建议我们休息一下。

name: Summarize
例文: Can you summarize the main points of the article?
例文翻译: 你能总结一下这篇文章的要点吗？

name: Support
例文: The evidence supports the theory.
例文翻译: 证据支持该理论。

name: Survey
例文: We surveyed 500 people for the study.
例文翻译: 我们为这项研究调查了500人。

name: Target
例文: The advertising campaign targets young adults.
例文翻译: 广告活动的目标受众是年轻人。

name: Transform
例文: Technology has transformed the way we live.
例文翻译: 技术改变了我们的生活方式。

name: Translate
例文: The book has been translated into twenty languages.
例文翻译: 这本书已被翻译成二十种语言。

name: Understand
例文: I don't understand what you mean.
例文翻译: 我不明白你的意思。

name: Update
例文: Don't forget to update your software.
例文翻译: 别忘了更新你的软件。

name: Verify
例文: We need to verify the accuracy of the data.
例文翻译: 我们需要验证数据的准确性。
